title: Fourier influence threshold
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, a real number $\varepsilon$, and a nonnegative integer $k$, define the threshold $\varepsilon^2/I(f)^2\cdot 9^{-k}$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
